problem.help: The observed problem statement the question chain starts from.

nodes.help: The branching question tree. Each question has an identifier, its level from 1 to 5, the identifier of the question it sits under (none on level 1), its answer and its sub-questions. Level 5 is the root cause and has no sub-questions. Bulk data: unless this field is requested explicitly, reading returns only the extent, the number of questions and the depth.

id.help: The identifier of the question, a whole number from 1; the commands address a question by it.

level.help: The level of the question: 1 for the first Why question, 5 for the root cause.

parentId.help: The identifier of the question this one sits under; none on level 1.

answer.help: The answer to the Why question — a cause, not a culprit.

children.help: The sub-questions of the next level, in display order; level 5 has none.

stats.help: Key figures of the tree as in the statistics bar: number of questions, maximum depth, branches and answered questions.

addRoot.help: Adds a new first-level Why question at the end and returns its identifier.

params.command: The command as an empty object.

addChild.help: Adds the next Why level below a question and returns its identifier; the question expands. Refused on the root-cause level (level 5).

params.parentId: Identifier of the question the new level is added to. An unknown identifier or a question on level 5 is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with parentId.

setAnswer.help: Writes the answer to a Why question.

params.nodeId: Identifier of the question whose answer is set. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.text: The answer — a cause, not a culprit.
params.command: The command as an object with nodeId and text.

removeNode.help: Removes a question together with every question below it.

params.nodeId: Identifier of the question to remove. An unknown identifier is an error.
params.command: The command as an object with nodeId.

toggleCollapse.help: Collapses or expands a question with its sub-questions.

params.nodeId: Identifier of the question. An unknown identifier is an error.

setCollapseAll.help: Collapses or expands every question that has sub-questions.

params.collapsed: True collapses all, false expands all.

FiveWhyStats.totalNodes: The number of questions in the tree.
FiveWhyStats.maxDepth: The deepest level holding a question; 0 without questions.
FiveWhyStats.branches: The branches: for every question with more than one sub-question, their count minus one, summed.
FiveWhyStats.answered: The number of questions with an answer.
